top_signals.title: New GPUThor attack defeats NVIDIA ECC protection for root access
top_signals.summary: A newly disclosed Rowhammer attack called GPUThor can bypass error-correcting code (ECC) protections on NVIDIA GPUs, enabling denial-of-service (DoS) and root-level privilege escalation. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
